verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI for release management, source map uploads and debug-file handling, which are classic CI pipeline tasks. Programmatic automation is further supported by a web API for managing resources and exporting data, deploy notifications, a Bitbucket Pipelines build integration, and Seer code review on GitHub/GitLab PRs. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline docs (e.g. GitHub Actions or non-interactive token auth setup), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
